CONTEXT_TRANSITION.trigger_for_switch: Omission scare plus explicit order for JD-term weaving with skip-free and interview-safe guarantees

psychological_state.decision_style: Owner states design intent as recalled contract plus inviolable constraints, then judges by live proof at each gate.

interaction_pairing.user_action: Demanded omission forensics across latest resumes, then ordered AI reframing (JD terms, nothing skipped, no new tech) and docs updates.
interaction_pairing.ai_response_quality: Forensic diff proved 63/63 preservation (reorder perception, not omission); implemented per-role AI reframe with count/numbers/tech-allowlist validation and offline skip; live run caught marker-stripping via the new guardrail and the normalizer fixed it to 63/63; docs versioned; gates green.
interaction_pairing.friction_points: 1) Early diff scripts miscounted (heading-level bug) — corrected with explicit scripts, not one-liners. 2) Single-word tech detection is shape-impossible — resolved as hard gates plus audit tripwire, stated openly. 3) Live reframe exposed marker stripping — guardrail plus normalizer the same session.
interaction_pairing.resolution: Reframe live with 63/63 preserved; tripwire logs novel Capitalized words; offline mode keeps originals silently.

cognitive_evolution.new_pattern_detected: Brain-proposes/Python-disposes with per-unit atomic fallback: AI output is accepted only when machine-checkable invariants hold (count, numbers subset, token allowlist); otherwise originals stand. Generalizes beyond resumes to any AI rewrite task.
cognitive_evolution.changed_from_prior_belief: Previously assumed reorder-only tailoring was sufficient and omission was the only risk. Now: formatting channels (markers) degrade silently too, and single-word tech needs tripwires not rules.
cognitive_evolution.consistency_with_axioms: Axiom 1 (diffs and live runs over impressions). Axiom 2 (config flag, zero new literals). Axiom 4 (residual openly documented instead of hidden).

long_term_application.future_implication: 1) Every AI rewrite feature ships with same-shape validators plus formatting normalization. 2) Audit-word tripwires cover what hard rules cannot without false rejects. 3) Offline/no-brain paths must degrade to originals with zero stalls. 4) Diff artifacts first on any quality-drift report.
long_term_application.cross_project_note: Propose-validate-fallback pattern transfers to any generative rewrite pipeline.
